# Mallcom India

> > Mallcom India is a leading manufacturer and supplier of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety footwear, gloves, protective clothing, and eye protection, certified to EN standards.

Mallcom Corporate specializes in industrial safety products with comprehensive certifications including EN 20345:2022 for safety footwear, EN 388:2016 for protective gloves, and PPE regulation 2016/425 compliance. The company offers steel-toe boots, cut-resistant gloves, heat-resistant workwear, and specialized PPE for construction, welding, and industrial environments.

## Key Topics

- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- EN 20345:2022 Safety Footwear Standard
- EN 388:2016 Protective Gloves Standard
- Steel Toe Safety Boots
- Cut-Resistant Gloves
- Heat-Resistant Workwear
- Slip-Resistant & Oil-Resistant Footwear
- Grain Leather Driver Gloves
- Industrial Safety Compliance
- PPE Regulation 2016/425
- Abrasion Resistance
- Welding Protection Equipment
- High-Visibility Workwear
- Construction Safety Gear
- Nitrile Coated Gloves

## Safety Footwear & Boots

- [MALLARD 18 - Steel Toe Leather Safety Boots](https://mallcom.in/products/mallard-18): MALLARD 18 steel toe leather safety boots with EN 20345:2022 certification
- [PAMPAS - Anti-Slip Slip-Resistant Work Boots](https://mallcom.in/products/pampas): PAMPAS slip-resistant safety boots with S1/S3 certification & anti-slip soles
- [ONTILLA - High Ankle Safety Shoes](https://mallcom.in/products/ontilla): ONTILLA high ankle steel toe safety shoes with Cordura & EN 20345:2022
- [OCELOT - Lightweight Steel Toe Safety Shoes](https://mallcom.in/products/ocelot): OCELOT lightweight steel toe safety shoes with EN ISO 20345:2011 S1 rating
- [MALKIN - Industrial Safety Boots](https://mallcom.in/products/malkin): MALKIN high ankle industrial safety boots with steel toe & EN 20345:2022
- [RUFUS M01 - Mid-Ankle Safety Shoes](https://mallcom.in/products/rufus-m01): RUFUS M01 mid-ankle steel toe safety shoes with EN ISO 20345:2011 standard
- [MANUL 2 - Tactical Desert Boots](https://mallcom.in/products/manul-2): MANUL 2 tactical desert boots with suede leather & EN 20347:2012 standard
